sections.heading: What it is
sections.body: Two cohorts a year in Mount Shasta, California. Mornings move, afternoons go inward, and evenings are fire, food and circle.
points: Daily Qi Gong and team training
Sweat lodge and rite of passage

sections.heading: After you get home
sections.body: You leave with a take-home practice, a private brotherhood group and an integration call one week later.

faq.q: Do I need to be fit?
faq.a: No. Everything is scalable in the moment.

faq.q: Is it a personal-development retreat or a training camp?
faq.a: Both: the training is real, and so is the inner work.
